name: Song ad (sung story, animated)

signed.ruling: his rulings of 2026-10-09/10 cover every line (cited per line under rulings): punch first + shorter + flow (SONG-WRITING.md); match the swipe's style; nobody talks, all clips, no stills, Seedance 480p one take + local upscale; product never drawn; cost down "even more".

what: A dramatic first-person story told as a real song (2:30–3:15). The song is made first and the whole cut follows it: every sung line is a silent clip in the swipe's animated style, nobody talks on screen, the product arrives late, rendered in the film's style from the real product photo, and only the end card is the real packshot.

specialised.what: the song is made and passed before any picture
specialised.why: the cut is derived from the song's timing; SONG-WRITING.md (the owner 2026-10-10)

specialised.what: song flow: gaps up to 3.5 s, dead air up to 10%, 6 beats a rapped line / 8 a ballad line
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-10: the first tight pass sounded rushed — "it needs to actually sound like a song, just efficient"

specialised.what: the product is rendered in the film's style from the real product photo, held by the cast; only the end card is the real packshot
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-10: "you shouldn't be using real b-roll for this" — in an animated ad real footage breaks the film. This OVERRIDES the general 'product is never drawn → real footage' route for stylised formats; that route still holds for real-footage / UGC formats

specialised.what: nobody talks; every scene is a silent clip — no stills ever
specialised.why: attention-first song ads; a held still reads as slop (the owner 2026-10-10)

specialised.what: Seedance 2.5 at 480p, one take, then local Real-ESRGAN upscale
specialised.why: ~$0.13/s at 480p vs about $0.57/s at 1080p; sloppy B-roll is fine under a song (the owner 2026-10-10)

specialised.what: pictures at high quality on the house picture model (2026-10-21, VIDEO-RULINGS V17 — was medium on the fast tier), made at 9:16, no framing-fix calls
specialised.why: pictures were $3.5–7/ad of the spend on xhigh 2:3 + zone-fix remakes; the clips are 480p so xhigh detail is thrown away (cost ruling 2026-10-10)

specialised.what: scenes are set-ups, never lyric lines (VIDEO-RULINGS V35): one place and camera set-up per scene, a clear start and stop, the lyric beats played inside it; one start picture per scene, a returning set-up reuses its picture
specialised.why: one picture per line made 40–57 pictures an ad (and 33 frames on 21 Oct); the owner 2026-10-23: "less frames and more just describing what's in the scene"

specialised.what: recurring cast and sets across stories
specialised.why: the 10-09/10 runs already re-used banked family-3d people; a new cast per story is wasted spend

specialised.what: hooks are cut from existing clips, never generated
specialised.why: h-a..h-d were 3 s scroll stoppers from the story's shocking beats, $0 extra

stage_order: scene pictures (board, the owner OKs each)

audio.song_how: made by hand in Suno from song.py --suno (model-inputs suno sheet + the style row's suno line); brought back with song.py --from-file through the song gate (the owner, 2026-10-28)
audio.sung_on_camera: the singer sings his lines on camera like a musical: each sung scene's slice of the song (song.py sung_reads → vo/<scene>.mp3) is that scene's read, and its clip is a lip-synced talking clip; story shots stay silent over the song (the owner, 2026-10-28)

song.punch_first: the story's most shocking line sung in the first second — no intro, no humming, no beat-only bar
song.sections: fit (lines × beats_per_line + tail beats at the row's tempo) — never a hand-written number
song.brand_line: said plainly once in the bridge and in the outro tag; a dropped tag is fixed by crossfading an 8 s tag in the same style
song.sound: it needs to actually sound like a song, just efficient: a melody, a sung hook, fewer syllables per line; short musical breaks are fine (under the 3.5 s gap)
song.flow_why: the owner 2026-10-10 (second pass): max gap 3.5 s, dead air ≤10%, first word ≤1 s; rap 6 beats a line, ballads 8 — "it needs to actually sound like a song, just efficient"

pictures.made_at: 9:16 directly at 864x1536 — exact 9:16, both sides divide by 16 (the API takes any such size: tools/image-production/models.json note, 2026-09-22); the clip is 480p so a bigger picture is thrown away
pictures.style_lock: the swipe's style row, formula first (family-3d on every run so far)
pictures.product: image-to-image from the real product photo, restyled into the swipe's style; shape, colour and label exact

clips.upscale: local Real-ESRGAN realesr-animevideov3 x3 to 1080x1920, crf 15
clips.short_clip: slow to no less than 0.75x, then play the rest in reverse (ping-pong) — never hold a frame
clips.prompt_order: action line + style lock FIRST, then motion; nothing else
clips.refused_every_try: the same prompt and references to the backup door (VIDEO-RULINGS V21); never the neighbour clip punched in (VIDEO-RULINGS V15)
clips._seedance: 2026-10-26: every clip is Seedance 2.5 at 480p, one take and three tries at most (VIDEO-RULINGS V34, MODEL-HOUSE.md); a clip is 4 s at the least
clips._model_why: the owner, 2026-10-29: Seedance 2.0 for song ads (generative-model-house clips.song_ad); every other format stays Seedance 2.5

cast.reuse: banked people and sets in the swipe's style first, across stories
cast.product: ANIMATED STYLE RULE: the product is rendered IN THE FILM'S STYLE, image-to-image from the real product photo (shape, colour and label kept exact), held by the banked cast and animated like every other scene; only the end card is the real packshot. Real archive footage and studio renders in the body are refused for an animated style.

hooks.shape: ~3 s scroll stopper cut from the story's most shocking clip, punched in 1.10→1.30x, a lyric line as text + one bank SFX, then into the first sung line

captions.look: lyric lines in the swipe's caption look; the control opens on the first sung line with a headline at 16% from the top

apply: clip words check (no words on the picture)
product in the film's style from the real photo (no real footage in the body)
skip: lip-sync / line parity on clips (nobody talks)

edit.method: video-edit machine cut on the song's clock (renders on python3.14)
edit.reuse: second chorus and outro reuse earlier clips whole — never punched in (VIDEO-RULINGS V15)
edit.end_card: camera move on the real packshot / studio render — the ONLY real product pixels in an animated song ad
edit.garbled_background_text: blur at the edit (gblur sigma 22), never a punch-in past it (VIDEO-RULINGS V15)
edit.loudness: -14 LUFS, true peak ≤ -1 dBTP (limit the song first)

copy.why: the copywriter drifts to the story plot from the brand files otherwise

failures.failure: songs 5½–6 min with 35–90 s dead air; first word 12 s in
failures.fix: punch line first, sections fit from lines × beats_per_line, every take listened to by song.py flow()

failures.failure: brand line / last line dropped or blurred by the music model
failures.fix: cut before it and crossfade an 8 s tag in the same style

failures.failure: cast made photoreal for an animated swipe
failures.fix: the teardown names the style row; every element and frame is made in it (family-3d)

failures.failure: The clip model 'could not generate' on a full-size PNG start picture
failures.fix: send the start picture centre-cropped to 9:16 as a 432x768 JPEG q90

failures.failure: The clip model re-framed a 2:3 picture / refused it
failures.fix: the picture goes in at 9:16; a 9:16 crop passed where the 2:3 was refused
action line + style lock first; reword the action, never resend the same request; shorten to action + style + motion

failures.failure: a clip refused on every try
failures.fix: the same prompt and references to the backup door (VIDEO-RULINGS V21); never the neighbour clip punched in (VIDEO-RULINGS V15)

failures.failure: clip shorter than its lyric window filled with a still push-in
failures.fix: slow to ≥0.75x then reverse (ping-pong); never a still
blur on the start picture, or at the edit (gblur 22) — never a punch-in past it (VIDEO-RULINGS V15)

failures.failure: real brands drawn in pictures (snacks, batteries)
shower scenes refused by the picture filter
product label misspelt / a stranger drawn into the packshot
failures.fix: the product is restyled image-to-image from the real product photo with its label kept exact (never drawn from words); end card = camera push on the real packshot

failures.failure: copywriter cards drifted to the story plot
failures.fix: name AD-SCRIPT.md (the sung lyrics) as the copy source

failures.failure: control and a hook version held at -0.7/-0.8 dBTP
failures.fix: limit the song first (alimiter 0.6) and master to ≤ -1 dBTP

failures.failure: zone-fix picture remakes unbilled on the ledger and doubling picture calls
failures.fix: make at 9:16 directly; framing-fix calls off

failures.failure: real archive B-roll / studio renders cut into an animated film
failures.fix: refused for animated styles — the product is rendered in the film's style from the real photo, held by the banked cast
failures.from_run: runs/video-production/brand-a/reddit-it-was-me-brand-a (inserts.json product_rule) — ruled out by the owner 2026-10-10

cost._cap: 2026-10-21 (P40, VIDEO-RULINGS V17: cost is never a reason): no dollar cap stops an ad; three of every element, the best kept.
cost.measured: ledger $9.67–16.31 an ad on 8 runs (pictures $3.49–7.02, clips $6.18–10.38) — pictures understated (zone-fix rows unbilled), element sheets ~$2.40–4.70 more, song not on the ledger; ~$18–27 all in
cost.how: pictures high on the house picture model at 9:16 (V17, 2026-10-21 — was medium on the fast tier), no fix calls, 2–3 clips per picture (~20 pictures not ~50); clips 3–4 s at 480p (~45 × 3.5 s × $0.13 ≈ $20 for a 2:45 song); cast and sets reused (element sheets ≈ $0); hooks cut from clips ($0)

quality_bar: the first sung word lands inside 1 s and it is the story's punch line
no gap over 2 s between sung words; dead air under 5% (song.py flow)
every picture in the swipe's style row — no photoreal person in an animated ad
every shot moves: no still, no frozen frame, no held last frame
no readable garbage text anywhere on screen (blurred, never punched past)
no stranger, no merged faces, no real third-party brand in frame
every clip sits under the lyric it illustrates
the brand line is heard plainly once in the bridge and in the outro
the product matches the real photo exactly (shape, colour, label) AND is in the film's style — no real footage in the body; the end card is the real packshot
it sounds like a song: a melody and a sung hook, not a rushed list of lines
the story is real: real cheating, real scandal, real stakes; never a softened version (the owner, 2026-10-28: "I want the cheating to be real")
innuendo and sus pushed right up to the edge line (Story Playbook): double meanings, 'pause', near-curses; never over it
every scene has one shocking thing a viewer would screenshot
it watches like a music video and a movie at once: the singer's performance shots intercut with the story, shot sizes varied (wide, medium, close), every shot staged and lit like film
depth in every scene: built from its 3D room with a real lens and light, never a flat backdrop
the clip model is used to its limit: camera moves, physical acting, emotion travelling through the shot; never a held pose
upscaled to 1080x1920 before launch; nothing ships at the clip model's working resolution
built_from: runs/video-edit/brand-a/* and runs/video-edit/brand-b/* (the matching edits + -h-* hook versions)
rulings: the owner 2026-10-10 (SONG-WRITING.md): "the opening line needs to start with the punch … these songs need to be shorter … the songs need to flow"
the owner 2026-10-09 (THE-CHAIN.md): "the creative format itself is supposed to look like Pixar" — the swipe's style is the lock
the owner 2026-10-10 (memory: song ads all clips, cheap): no stills ever; Seedance 480p + local upscale; sloppy B-roll is fine
the owner 2026-10-10 (attention-first song ads): no voiceover, silent scenes follow the sung story
the owner 2026-10-09/10 (CLAUDE.md, product never drawn): "all this slop stuff is gone … so we can print ads"
the owner 2026-10-10: "how can we get our cost down even more" — the cost defaults above
the owner 2026-10-10: "we cannot have AI slop" — the quality bar
the owner 2026-10-10: "you shouldn't be using real b-roll for this" — animated formats render the product in the film's style from the real photo; only the end card is real
the owner 2026-10-10: "it needs to actually sound like a song, just efficient" — max gap 3.5 s, dead air ≤10%, rap 6 / ballad 8 beats a line

workflow.what: The song-ad line, station by station, on the components. Start it by name ('run the song-ad workflow'); every station is a component's own command, and the run stops at every gate for the person named.
workflow.ruled: the owner, 2026-10-28: "creating proper workflows like in the repo itself. So like we can just say this activate this specific workflow. That way the consistency is 100%."

doors.scratch: Our own story, no swipe: a concept from the research bank (deliverable/CONCEPT-BRIEF.md) goes in with the picks.
doors.swipe: A swipe that already works: video-teardown takes it apart first, and its record replaces the picks' structure.

steps.name: The idea
steps.does: A concept from the research bank, or a swipe torn down

steps.name: Awareness and arc
steps.does: The awareness level picks the arc; the arc's beats are the section plan (creative_controls.arcs_for / section_plan) (recorded in the run when scratch.py or the teardown opens it)

steps.name: Writing
steps.does: Injection, hooks, script, audit, spice and the brief; dials, spice, culture and the Story Playbook read in

steps.name: Brief review
steps.does: the owner reads the brief and OKs it; the production run opens only after his OK, so it is the mark that he did

steps.name: Song first (Suno)
steps.component: video-production song.py (Suno inputs) · suno.com by hand · the song gate
steps.does: Production start writes song/suno-inputs.json from the brief's song block (model-inputs suno sheet) and waits; the song is made in Suno, then brought in and gated: every line heard in order, the flow listened to, the timing kept for the scenes

steps.name: Cast and rooms
steps.does: The cast in the film's style (banked first) and a 3D room for every set, so each scene has depth and a lens

steps.name: Scene pictures
steps.does: One picture per scene from its room, cast and lens; the owner OKs every one

steps.name: Hand-off
steps.does: The brief, the song and every approved picture in one folder, here and on the Drive

steps.name: Clips and the cut
steps.does: the team: every shot of the singer is a lip-synced clip on the song (the singer sings his line, a musical), story shots silent over it; B-roll, effects, the cut under the song

steps.name: Upscale
steps.does: Every finished cut to 1080x1920 in one batch before launch

steps.name: Launch
steps.does: the owner's review, the names, the approval card; only the owner's click goes live
